built_from: The Notebook pages "Evaluation: target, measures and baseline" (revision 9) and "Measurements" (revision 4), and the posts each reading names

target.text: People and agents carry out shared work in Theseus with a goal both can state, nothing said or written is lost, and every change shows whether it made that work better without breaking what already worked.

checks.group_name: Nothing said or written is lost
checks.name: Every unit check passes
checks.explain: These include the integrity checks aim-core counted: one message for an exact retry, new writing kept through an older send, reading never counted as acknowledging, and Notebook history kept word for word.
checks.proves: nothing said or written is lost

checks.group_name: Nothing said or written is lost
checks.name: Every browser check passes, one at a time, on a quiet Mac
checks.explain: A red result counts only when it repeats on a quiet Mac.
checks.proves: nothing said or written is lost

checks.name: An agent is woken soon after a message reaches it
checks.explain: One reading, so no target yet: numbers first, then a target.
checks.proves: every change shows whether it made that work better

checks.name: An agent posts again after a message addressed to it
checks.explain: This is the agent's next post in the topic, not necessarily its answer. How long an answer takes is not measured yet.
checks.proves: every change shows whether it made that work better

checks.name: Turns that start with nothing waiting
checks.explain: Decided on 5 Nov: the 60-second re-wake stays, and these turns are counted, because both fixes on offer could leave work stranded.
checks.proves: every change shows whether it made that work better

checks.name: How long a topic takes to open as it grows
checks.pending_words: No timing check yet: it comes with speed checks on every deploy (13)
checks.proves: every change shows whether it made that work better

checks.name: How long a message takes to appear on someone else's page
checks.pending_words: No timing check yet: it comes with speed checks on every deploy (13)
checks.proves: every change shows whether it made that work better

checks.name: How long an agent takes to acknowledge a delivery
checks.pending_words: Theseus does not record when a delivery is acknowledged yet
checks.proves: every change shows whether it made that work better

checks.group_name: We can both state the goal
checks.name: You and the working agent state the same goal
checks.pending_words: No sample yet: it needs your own words and the agent's, written separately
checks.explain: Three questions, answered separately by you and by the agent doing the work: What result are we after? What is the next useful step, and who takes it? What would show it's done? The answers are compared for meaning, not wording, and recorded as matching, different, or not yet compared.
checks.proves: with a goal both can state

checks.name: A deploy refuses any commit that has not passed every check
checks.explain: Shipped in release 19 (3). The deploy itself checks that every step of the release check passed.

checks.name: Problems you find that no check caught
checks.explain: Each problem found in the live app before any check caught it, under the release it was found in. A defect: the code did not do what was decided. A design miss: it did what was decided, and that was wrong. Fewer per release is the aim.

runs.from: Measurements page, the 5 Nov afternoon baseline (aim-ux and aim-core, #352 and #353)
